name: Apple M5 Max (40-core GPU)
notes: Apple's tech specs: 40-core GPU, 16-core Neural Engine, 614 GB/s. Unit counts by the per-core rule the review sites list (128 ALUs, 8 TMUs, 4 ROPs per GPU core). 512-bit at 9.6 Gbps reproduces 614 GB/s; Apple prints neither. Apple publishes no clock, TDP or tensor figure: the clock is the top of the GPU's DVFS table as macOS reports it, the FP32 figure is 128 ALUs x 2 x that clock.

name: Apple M5 Max (32-core GPU)
notes: Apple's tech specs: 32-core GPU, 16-core Neural Engine, 460 GB/s. 4096 / 256 / 128 as the review sites list; 384-bit at 9.6 Gbps reproduces 460 GB/s.

name: Apple M5 Pro (20-core GPU)
notes: Apple's tech specs: 20-core GPU, 16-core Neural Engine, 307 GB/s. Unit counts by the same per-core rule; 256-bit at 9.6 Gbps reproduces 307 GB/s.

name: Apple M5 (10-core GPU)
notes: Apple's newsroom: 10-core GPU with a Neural Accelerator in each core, 16-core Neural Engine, 153 GB/s. Unit counts by the per-core rule; 128-bit at 9.6 Gbps reproduces 153 GB/s.
